The '''''Harbinger''''' was a [[Sith dreadnaught]] active in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. It was commanded by [[Saes Rrogon]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-turned-[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. The ''Harbinger'' and another dreadnaught, the ''[[Omen]]'', were transporting [[Lignan]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] to Sith Lord [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] when the two ships were [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|ambushed]] by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. ''Harbinger'' was infiltrated by [[Relin Druur]], Saes' former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], who managed to sabotage its hyperdrive while Druur's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Drev Hassin]], held off several of ''Harbinger''{{'s}} [[Blade-class starfighter|own fighters]]. Eventually, Hassin managed to ram the [[Infiltrator (starfighter)|Infiltrator]] into the Harbinger's bridge, causing the ''Harbinger'' to crash into the ''Omen'' just as the vessels escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The collision knocked the ''Omen'' off-course, causing it to crash into the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].

''Harbinger'' itself jumped through an unstable hyperspace tunnel which caused it to [[Time travel/Legends|travel]] through [[Time/Legends|time]] to the year [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. There, Relin again [[Mission to the Harbinger|faced Saes]] and used the Lignan ore power to kill Rrogon. Then, Druur sent the ''Harbinger'' crashing on the surface of the [[frozen moon]] below, destroying the ship and killing Druur.
